shortDescription: Notify New Relic about app deployments

options.name: app_name
options.description: The value of C(app_name) in the C(newrelic.yml) file used by the application. One of O(app_name) or O(application_id) is required.

options.name: app_name_exact_match
options.description: If this flag is set to V(true) then the application ID lookup by name would only work for an exact match. If set to V(false) it returns the first result.

options.name: application_id
options.description: The application ID found in the metadata of the application in APM. One of O(app_name) or O(application_id) is required.

options.name: changelog
options.description: A list of changes for this deployment.

options.name: description
options.description: Text annotation for the deployment - notes for you.

options.name: revision
options.description: A revision number (for example, git commit SHA).

options.name: token
options.description: API token to place in the Api-Key header.

options.name: user
options.description: The name of the user/process that triggered this deployment.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
